newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market poorly tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market poorly tested - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared Wednesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers poorly tested, USDA said. Trade and demand was ligh to moderate. Seller interest light.
